name: Iron Hunters
description:
About This Game

Unleash Mech Mayhem on Alien Worlds!

Iron Hunters is a fast-paced survivor-like where you pilot evolving mechs through bullet-hell infernos!

Hunt criminals across planets, battling swarms of vicious aliens. Dodge deadly patterns, combine weapons for insane synergies, and unlock permanent upgrades.

Features:

  • Deep Customization: Unlock permanent weapons, mech, parts, and power-ups across runs for endless build variety.

  • Risk vs. Reward: High-risk paths lead to elite enemies, mercenaries, and game-changing loot.

  • Skill-Based Mayhem: Precise dodging, positioning, and timing turn chaos into triumph.

  • Diverse Biomes: From icy tundra with crimson flora to volcanic hellscapes
short_desc: Pilot customizable mechs in this survivor-like packed with chaotic bullet-hell combat. Upgrade, evolve, and combine weapons mid-run to create game-breaking synergies as you battle hordes of enemies across alien worlds.
